main_measure.name: t of OLS slope of excess 72-bar forward return on forecast, active grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with check > 0), reject if t <= -2, at least 200 cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess return above median forecast minus below median

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the high-minus-low median split is above 0, with at least 200 cases.
reading: The coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean of all its non-overlapping grid 72-bar returns over all windows, the regression is OLS with an intercept, and cases exactly at the median forecast are left out of the median split.
